epiphany.configuration.title: Epiphany Configs
Maximum number of Epiphany slots a player can have.
Number of Insight Points required to select a Module.
epiphany.configuration.maxSelectedModule: Maximum number of Modules a player can select at the same time.
epiphany.configuration.progression.maxTo: Maximum total Insight Points per player (spent + unspent). -1 means unlimited; 0 prevents new points. Reaching the limit stops aptitude and new point gains. Spending points does not restore the allowance. Lowering the limit preserves existing points and aptitude; growth stops when the total is at or above the new limit.
epiphany.configuration.progression.baseA: Aptitude required to earn the first Insight Point; must be a positive integer. The next point costs this value + total Insight Points (spent + unspent) times the aptitude cost increase per point. Server rules are synced to clients.
epiphany.configuration.progression.aptit: How much the next point's aptitude cost increases for each additional total Insight Point; must be a nonnegative integer. 0 keeps the cost constant. Spending points does not reduce the cost. Rule changes preserve aptitude until the next positive gain triggers settlement.
epiphany.configuration.notifyInsightPoin: Send a chat message and play a sound when the player gains Insight Points through aptitude progression, commands, or rewards.
epiphany.configuration.notifyModuleUnloc: Send a chat message and play a sound when a Module is unlocked through a condition or command. Modules that are initially selectable do not trigger a notification.
epiphany.configuration.notifyEpiphanyUnl: Send a chat message and play a sound when an Epiphany is unlocked through a condition or command. Epiphanies that are initially selectable do not trigger a notification.
